system.description:
Size Medium • Speed 30ft • Darkvision 120ft • +2 Dex / +1 Int, −1 Wis

Traits

  • Immune to magical sleep.
  • Advantage on saves vs charm.
  • Trance (4hr rest).
  • Advantage on Perception (sight/hearing) in low light or darkness.
  • Innate Dancing Lights at will; Darkness or Faerie Fire, 1/day (choose one when cast; Faerie Fire allows a Reflex save, Ancestry Save DC, Charisma).
  • Weapon training: hand crossbow, shortsword, rapier.
  • Armour training: light.
  • Sunlight Sensitivity varies by faith: Nu'Dravi who worship Eilistraee are exempt entirely.
  • Nu'Dravi of no faith or a neutral faith get a lesser version (Disadvantage only in the first hour of direct sunlight exposure per day).
  • Drow who worship Lolth keep full Sunlight Sensitivity (disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks in direct sunlight).
